notes: Content Designer: Omen's meters, gauges and graphs can now be placed on any card that has a number to show. Meters come in Bar, Pill, Handle and Dashed; gauges in Ring, Dot, Segments and Crest; graphs in Dotted Flow, Waves, Pulse, Peaks…

Each one follows a reading you choose and is measured against a range: load and temperature go to 100 by default, and clock, power, network and memory use the reading's own maximum (the rated clock, power limit, link speed or total). Type…
